title: Join us for OpenAI’s first developer conference on November 6 in San Francisco
summary: Developer registration for in-person attendance will open in the coming weeks and developers everywhere will be able to livestream the keynote.
body: Developer registration for in-person attendance will open in the coming weeks and developers everywhere will be able to livestream the keynote.
summaryZh: OpenAI官方宣布将于11月6日在旧金山举办其首届开发者大会（DevDay）。开发者可参与现场注册并观看主题演讲直播，这标志着OpenAI在推动其AI生态和开发者社区建设方面迈出了重要一步。原始信息显示：Developer registration for in-person attendance will open in the coming weeks and developers everywhere will be able to livestream the keynote.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Join us for OpenAI’s first developer conference on November 6 in San Francisco”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI宣布举办首届开发者大会，对了解其生态和后续发布具有重要行业风向标意义。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
